fixed.member: fantasy, scifi and cartoon style packs
fixed.summary: Text reads at 4.5:1 on what each pack draws under it, in both schemes. Fantasy's light scheme turns its walnut frames, plates, panels, cells, fields and slots to parchment and vellum with dark inks, draws its hex buttons as bevelled vellum plates with brass rims, and pales its crimson bands under the dark title. Scifi darkens its light hover and accent inks and its pressed tab, and lightens its dark danger. Cartoon darkens its red and violet plates under white text, its light accent, and its dark hover and pressed washes. Text over the scene takes the default's eight-copy outline in --ink-inverse under all three, and fantasy's focus ring follows its pointed plates.
